newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weaker against dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weaker against dollar, pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against the dollar and pound on Tuesday as the U.S. currency shrugged off central bank dollar sales and continued to rise in international markets overnight, forex dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 20.224 against the dollar from 20.179 on Monday. The rupee traded at a mean of 32.7170 versus the pound from 32.6975.

"The central bank intervened in the market today by selling dollars to banks at a rate lower than the interbank rate," one dealer said. But dealers said they fixed the rupee weaker on Tuesday because of the bullish dollar overseas.
More forex inflow in the interbank market was also seen on Tuesday with a Mauritius Sugar Syndicate tender sale of pounds obtained from the islands sugar export proceeds.
